notes: Classification weights homepage, services, conversion routes and organization metadata above content topics and filenames.
Project technology, business offering, content topics and case-study stacks are recorded separately.

technical-seo.reason: Public web property; technical eligibility always in scope.

on-page-seo.reason: HTML documents exist or are expected.

content.reason: Content and intent mapping applies to public sites.

semantic-entity.reason: Entity clarity applies to organizations and services.

geo-aio.reason: Machine-understanding work is an extension of technical and entity foundations.

ecommerce.reason: No first-party catalog/checkout architecture. Client-delivery ecommerce copy is not enough.

marketplace.reason: No multi-seller inventory model on this property.

saas.reason: SaaS mentioned as a service offering is not SaaS-product SEO.

programmatic-seo.reason: Page volume is not a programmatic SEO system.

sem.reason: Google Ads is not connected and paid search was not authorized.

mobile-app.reason: Building mobile apps for clients is not ASO.
